text_en: After this I heard what seemed to be the loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power to our God,
text_cn: 这些事以后，我听见天上仿佛有一大伙人群发出的大声音说：“亚肋路亚！胜利、光荣和能力，应归于我们的天主，

text_en: for his judgments are true and just; he has judged the great whore who corrupted the earth with her fornication, and he has avenged on her the blood of his servants. ”
text_cn: 因为，他的判断是正确而正义的；他惩罚了那曾以自己的邪淫败坏了下地的大淫妇，并给被她所杀的仆人报了仇。”

text_en: Once more they said, “Hallelujah! The smoke goes up from her forever and ever. ”
text_cn: 他们又重复说：“亚肋路亚！她的烟向上直冒，至于无穷之世。”

text_en: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who is seated on the throne, saying, “Amen. Hallelujah! ”
text_cn: 于是，那二十四位长老和那四个活物，便俯伏朝拜那坐在宝座上的天主说：“阿们。亚肋路亚！”

text_en: And from the throne came a voice saying, “Praise our God, all you his servants, and all who fear him, small and great. ”
text_cn: 遂有声音由宝座那里发出说：“天主的众仆人，凡敬畏他的，无论大小，请赞美我们的天主罢！”

text_en: Then I heard what seemed to be the voice of a great multitude, like the sound of many waters and like the sound of mighty thunderpeals, crying out, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
text_cn: 我听见仿佛有一大伙人群的声音，就如大水的响声，又有如巨雷的响声，说：“亚肋路亚！因为我们全能的天主，上主为王了！

text_en: Let us rejoice and exult and give him the glory, for the marriage of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready;
text_cn: 让我们欢乐鼓舞，将光荣归于他罢！因为羔羊的婚期来近了，他的新娘也准备好了；

text_en: to her it has been granted to be clothed with fine linen, bright and pure”— for the fine linen is the righteous deeds of the saints.
text_cn: 天主又赏赐她穿上了华丽而洁白的细麻衣：这细麻衣就是圣徒们的义行。”

text_en: And the angel said to me, “Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb. ” And he said to me, “These are true words of God. ”
text_cn: 有位天使给我说：“你写下：被召赴羔羊婚宴的人，是有福的！”他又给我说：“这都是天主真实的话。”

text_en: Then I fell down at his feet to worship him, but he said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your comrades who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy. ”
text_cn: 我就俯伏在他脚前要朝拜他；他给我说：“万不要这样作，我只是你和你那些为耶稣作见证的弟兄们的同仆，你只该朝拜天主！”因为预言之神就是为耶稣作证。

text_en: Then I saw heaven opened, and there was a white horse! Its rider is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he judges and makes war.
text_cn: 随后我看见天开了，见有一匹白马；骑马的那位，称为“忠信和真实者”，他凭正义去审判，去作战。

text_en: His eyes are like a flame of fire, and on his head are many diadems; and he has a name inscribed that no one knows but himself.
text_cn: 他的眼睛有如火焰，他头上戴着许多冠冕，还有写的一个名号，除他自己外，谁也不认识；

text_en: He is clothed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is called The Word of God.
text_cn: 他身披一件染过血的衣服，他的名字叫作：“天主的圣言”。

text_en: And the armies of heaven, wearing fine linen, white and pure, were following him on white horses.
text_cn: 天上的军队也乘着白马，穿着洁白的细麻衣跟随着他。

text_en: From his mouth comes a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and he will rule them with a rod of iron; he will tread the wine press of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
text_cn: 从他口中射出一把利剑，用来打败异民；他要用铁杖统治他们，并践踏那充满全能天主忿怒的榨酒池。

text_en: On his robe and on his thigh he has a name inscribed, “King of kings and Lord of lords. ”
text_cn: 在衣服上，即在盖他大腿的衣服上写着“万王之王，万主之主”的名号。

text_en: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and with a loud voice he called to all the birds that fly in midheaven, “Come, gather for the great supper of God,
text_cn: 我又看见一位天使，站在太阳上，大声向一切飞翔于天空的飞鸟喊说：“请你们来一齐赴天主的大宴席，

text_en: to eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of the mighty, the flesh of horses and their riders—flesh of all, both free and slave, both small and great. ”
text_cn: 前来吃列王的肉、诸将帅的肉、众勇士的肉、骏马和骑马者的肉，并一切自主的或为奴的，以及大小人民的肉。”

text_en: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies gathered to make war against the rider on the horse and against his army.
text_cn: 我也看见那兽、地上的君王和他们的军队都聚在一起，要与骑马的那位和他的军队作战。

text_en: And the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had performed in its presence the signs by which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped its image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
text_cn: 可是，那兽被捉住了，在它面前行过奇迹，并藉这些奇迹，欺骗了那些接受那兽的印号，和朝拜兽像的那位假先知，也和它一起被捉住了；它们两个活活的被扔到那用硫磺燃烧的火坑里去了。

text_en: And the rest were killed by the sword of the rider on the horse, the sword that came from his mouth; and all the birds were gorged with their flesh.
text_cn: 其余的人也被骑马者口中所射出的剑杀死了；所有的飞鸟都吃饱了他们的肉。
